issues.description: The problem statement requires Farm to use a List<Animal> implemented as an ArrayList (aggregation using ArrayList), but the solution implements the animals collection as a Queue<Animal> backed by a LinkedList. The template Farm.java also does not declare the animals field yet, leaving ambiguity for students about the intended collection type. This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about which collection type to implement and which getter/setter types are expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the collection type across artifacts. Either update the solution to declare animals as a List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() (and have getters/setters use List<Animal>), or update the problem statement and UML to specify a Queue/LinkedList if that behavior is intended. Ensure the template Farm.java signature and comments reflect the chosen collection type so students implement the expected API.
